about: Example demo script for 'nano_cli.py play'. Coordinates and anchor images are PLACEHOLDERS - capture your own with 'nano_cli.py shot' + 'nano_cli.py crop'.

steps.say: Pin SmartConsole to a known position so fixed coordinates stay valid
Open Objects > New Host (Ctrl+N style shortcuts are more robust than clicks where available)
Publish and wait for the publish dialog to close
